script: Need a keeper by Sunday? Post an opening on Cancha. Say exactly who you need: the position, the level, the day you play. Players near you ask to join, and you pick who fits. Then chat in the app, no phone numbers. Coming to Cancha. Follow us and join the list at the link in our bio.
caption:
Short a keeper for Sunday? 🧤

Soon on Cancha, captains and clubs in Miami-Dade and Broward can post an opening and say exactly who they need: position, level, day and area. Players nearby ask to join, you pick who fits, and you chat in the app. No phone numbers shared.

Join the list at the link in our bio, and tag the captain who's always looking for a sub 👇

App screens, the opening card, join requests and chat show examples, not real players. Club crests as listed in the Cancha directory.
